title: Wandering stable components for complex Hénon maps
exact_target: Can a polynomial automorphism of the complex plane of dimension two have a wandering stable component? Determine both possible limit-map ranks and all three boundedness and volume alternatives.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems, record 5300079 (AMR-052-0079). CC BY 4.0.
